With every channel an identity in Q(N), the mechanism of the tier collapse is a statement about the channels alone: B is unpopulated by the carrier projection, D = 0 is u2 = 2u, and u2 = 2u is the L chain equalling the straight chain channel by channel. What is left is a proof of that equality from the contraction rather than a computation of it. Sharpened the same day (ADR 0030, runs/path_reduction_2026-09-04): on clusters with their private-link paths collapsed to weighted effective links -- which compute every cumulant identically, channel by channel -- the equality holds for each time-ordered insertion sequence separately and, within each, integrand by integrand as a value-preserving bijection; the single-contact dressing likewise once time is reversed, the end roles swapped and one end face conjugated. The object of the lemma is now known exactly (ADR 0031, runs/vertex_residuals_2026-09-04): integrating the middle face's private links alone does NOT make the two geometries the same function of the shared links and the end paths (14 of 124 terms); integrating the end paths as well does, in every term, coefficient for coefficient, as a formal word in the two shared links. So the lemma is: once each end face's private path has closed its two shared-link letters into a hairpin, the straight middle face Tr(U1 A U2 B-dagger), two private links of weight one, and the L middle face Tr(U1 U2 C-dagger), one private link of weight two, contract to the same two-link word under every wiring the Fierz rewirings produce on the four shared-link letters -- the energies by the path lemma, the Haar values by n = 1 cuts, the second cut's 1/N paid by a closed loop. A finite case analysis over those wirings is the proof. CLOSED AT FOURTH ORDER for the two-hop weight (ADR 0032, runs/universality_lemma_2026-09-04): phi -- delete the straight middle face's second private letter, keep the first as the weight-two link, reverse the second shared link -- is a coefficient-preserving bijection of the histories' integrands (124 terms, 536 integrands), and the Haar integral is phi-invariant on the whole family of words the Fierz swaps and cuts generate from the face words at the multiplicities fourth order reaches (exhaustive for a = b = 1 and (2,1), (1,2); sampled at (2,2)); on arbitrary wirings it is not. What remains: the lemma for arbitrary multiplicities (an inductive proof, needed at sixth order), and the same construction for the single-contact dressing and the fan. THE DRESSING TOO (ADR 0033, runs/dressing_lemma_2026-09-04): the face carrying both shared links is an end of the dressing's cumulant and the correspondence reverses time, so the straight cluster must be staged from the matching end (one resolvent expansion on the ket side, two on the bra side) -- staged naively only 52 of 128 terms pair off while every total agrees, which briefly read as a different mechanism. Staged right, phi (delete the hub private after the hub-end letter, keep the other as the weight-two link, reverse the hub-end link, conjugate) is a coefficient-preserving bijection in 128 of 128 terms, all 560 integrands have the Haar integral of their image over Q(N), and the mirror family is phi-invariant on the same counts. Every universality the fourth-order assembly uses now rests on the one identity; the fan is not needed (it cancels out of beta_N) and the corner has no partner geometry. What remains: the lemma for arbitrary multiplicities, on the mirror-symmetric family.

RESULT:HODGE_FESHBACH_SPLITTING.statement: On each cubic charge-odd plaquette Bloch fibre with q>0, the Feshbach complement of the cube-boundary carrier is the other Hodge summand. The exact identities are L_down+L_up=q I, L_down L_up=0, L_up=psi psi^dagger and psi^dagger psi=q, so Q=I-psi psi^dagger/q is the orthogonal projector onto ker L_up. Both Laplacians act scalarly on the carrier: L_down psi=0 and L_up psi=q psi. The Hodge algebra therefore generates no off-carrier coupling, and the excitation phi=Q R psi satisfies L_up phi=0. The denominator-cleared identities hold on the whole zone.
